answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded core assay. Each new agent must quarry a unique basalt specimen, hash its grain map, and lock that hash in escrow for twelve epochs. Around the bond, a reef of established graders samples one live work packet on every pulse of the epoch clock and seals the score. Spinning up a thousand sockpuppets means quarrying a thousand specimens and locking a thousand escrows; an honest miner does this once. A missed pulse slashes the bond, so cheap replicas bleed out before they can vote.
